voices.modelCard: Dataset: LJ Speech (https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/), license: public domain. Trained from scratch (not fine-tuned from the Lessac checkpoint). piper-voices repository license: MIT.
voices.caveat: Piper phonemizes with espeak-ng (GPL-3.0). Piper's maintainer has said he is unsure whether this affects generated audio (github.com/rhasspy/piper/discussions/271). Generated clips are treated as derived from a public-domain voice; review before commercial distribution.
voices.intendedUse: Offline, build-time generation of Milo's spoken dialogue clips (public/audio/voice/)

$pendingAnimals: cow, duck, pig, monkey: no real Public-domain/CC0 recording could be sourced (Wikimedia Commons search returned only spoken words for these). Not faked: they are excluded from the game until real files are added.
